test_catches_leaked_mock_by_default: test that leaked mock objects are caught by default using ExpectCall and OnCall filters
test_does_not_catch_when_disabled: test that leaked mock detection is disabled when --gmock_catch_leaked_mocks=0 flag is passed
test_catches_when_enabled: test that leaked mock detection works when --gmock_catch_leaked_mocks flag is explicitly enabled
test_catches_multiple_leaked_mocks: test that multiple leaked mock objects are caught when --gmock_catch_leaked_mocks is enabled
test_catches_with_explicit_flag_value: test that leaked mock detection works with --gmock_catch_leaked_mocks=1 explicit flag value
